note: Cached public datasets for the map modules. Refresh with: node scripts/update-data-packs.mjs

packs.name: Natural Earth countries (1:110m)
packs.description: Simplified country polygons with ISO codes, continent and population estimate. Also used to place country-level data.

packs.name: USGS earthquakes M2.5+ (past 7 days)
packs.description: Every M2.5+ earthquake worldwide in the last week. Weight scales with magnitude.

packs.name: abuse.ch Feodo Tracker botnet C2s (by country)
packs.description: Botnet C2 servers on the Feodo Tracker recommended blocklist, aggregated to country centroids (country-level location only; no IP geolocation).

packs.name: NOAA / NWS active weather alerts (US)
packs.description: Active National Weather Service alerts. Alerts with a polygon keep it; zone-based alerts are placed at the state or marine-area centre (approximate location).
